rawContent: @unite4strength @TheGabrielle_C @sagaftra Hi Gabrielle and all I seem to have got involved in this campaign pretty much by accident and while I applaud all the gains made for women in the age of #metoo I also see tremendous discontent in the grass roots of your union and it seems your leadership is strenuously challenged

@MatthewModine While many of us in the world were and are supportive of #metoo movement it is by no means a panacea and will not lead to the emancipation of women because first you need to emancipate the fucking men so get with your allies when you have them and then maybe everyone will succeed
